bedrock_prices_2026-09-21.why_a_high_bound_is_the_safe_direction: the meter reserves the WORST CASE before each call and refuses when the reservation will not fit. Over-pricing makes the $40 cap bind EARLIER; under-pricing lets real spend past it. A bound that is too high costs at most an arm stopping short and asking; a bound that is too low is the failure the cap exists to prevent.
